resources.string: Descriptive metadata for the next capture. The admitted slate stays frozen through recording and publication; edits during a take remain pending. Automatic numbering advances only after a saved capture and only if the slate has not changed. The UUID, not the take number, identifies a capture. These fields do not change filenames, detect a lens or collect GPS coordinates.
Slate changes pending for the next capture; the current capture retains its admitted metadata.
Use at most 128 UTF-16 units, without control characters, line breaks or invalid Unicode. This edit has not been saved.
Enter a whole number from 1 to 999999 without leading zeroes. This edit has not been saved.
Advance take number after a saved capture (never past 999999)
Saved media retained; check the next slate take number.
